skill_drafts.name: Agent Session Lifecycle Management
skill_drafts.description: Initialize, execute agent steps, and properly terminate an agent session with status reporting. Use when setting up and running a single agent interaction cycle.
skill_drafts.objective: Complete one full agent session from initialization through step execution to graceful termination
applicable_signals: User submits a query to the agent
Agent framework is ready and initialized
Single-turn or bounded interaction is required
contraindications: Continuous agent loops without explicit termination
Agent framework initialization is already complete and session is already active
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Initialize agent framework', 'detail': 'Set up the agent instance with required configuration'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Invoke agent.step(query)', 'detail': 'Pass user query to agent and await response'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Capture response', 'detail': "Store or process the agent's output"}
constraints: Agent must be initialized before step() is called
end_session() must be called with a status string to properly close the session
Session should not be reused after end_session() is invoked
cautions: Ensure step() response is captured before session termination
Always call end_session() to avoid resource leaks or incomplete logging
output_contract: Agent response retrieved and session terminated with success status recorded. Caller receives the agent's response object and confirmation that the session has been closed.

metadata.prompt: Execute a complete agent session: (1) initialize the agent framework, (2) invoke agent.step() with a user query, (3) capture the response, (4) call end_session() with a status string (e.g., 'Success'). Ensure the session is always terminated, even if step execution fails.
